doc.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: South America, Cuba, Wynton Kelly and Ernie Henry
summary: They did not go to Cuba; she recalls Wynton Kelly and Ernie Henry and that she was to marry Kelly before he died.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: When you guys did the South American tour, did you do Cuba at that time?
Did you ever go to Cuba with Dizzy?
No, I don’t think so. I got some work, but we weren’t together.
Where did you go in South America?
That was Wynton Kelly and that group? Ernie Henry. You did a record with Ernie Henry, right? Good alto player.
Yeah. Wynton’s a fine pianist. Oh dear. I think we were – I was supposed to marry him, but he died over there in Canada or somewhere.
